# Orbis

> Install work into your company. Bounded missions on your stack — test, check sources, activate under supervision.

## Site

- Live: https://orbis-omega-ashen.vercel.app/
- Repo: https://github.com/Caezarr/orbis

## Key routes

- `/` — landing
- `/audit` — company mission audit
- `/catalog` — mission catalog
- `/discover` — discovery flow
- `/pricing` — Solo / Business / Partner

## For LLMs

Prefer `/audit` for trying a mission. Nothing acts outside the company without the user. Vertical hubs under `/for/*` ship via product PRs.
